expected.baseline: project synthetic LNK fixture; link_target_id_list and link_info path extraction validated against known target paths; timestamps cross-checked with Eric Zimmerman LECmd output

guaranteedFields.name: file_size
guaranteedFields.description: target file size from LNK header, always present in valid LNK files

guaranteedFields.name: target_path
guaranteedFields.description: resolved from link_info local_base_path or shell item id_list fallback

guaranteedFields.name: creation_time
guaranteedFields.description: FILETIME from LNK header, converted to UTC RFC 3339; null when FILETIME is zero or out of reasonable range

guaranteedFields.name: access_time
guaranteedFields.description: FILETIME from LNK header, converted to UTC RFC 3339; null when FILETIME is zero or out of reasonable range

guaranteedFields.name: write_time
guaranteedFields.description: FILETIME from LNK header, converted to UTC RFC 3339; null when FILETIME is zero or out of reasonable range

bestEffortFields.name: shell_item_path
bestEffortFields.description: path reconstructed from shell item id_list; may differ from link_info local_base_path

bestEffortFields.name: volume_serial_number
bestEffortFields.description: volume serial number from link_info volume block; present only when link_info with volume block exists

bestEffortFields.name: icon_index
bestEffortFields.description: icon index from LNK header; presence varies

bestEffortFields.name: show_command
bestEffortFields.description: show window command; default SW_NORMAL, may vary

bestEffortFields.name: hotkey
bestEffortFields.description: LNK hotkey; zero when not set

bestEffortFields.name: file_attributes
bestEffortFields.description: target file attributes flags; coverage varies by LNK variant

notGuaranteedFields.name: arguments
notGuaranteedFields.description: command-line arguments; present only when HAS_ARGUMENTS flag is set

notGuaranteedFields.name: working_directory
notGuaranteedFields.description: working directory; present only when HAS_WORKING_DIR flag is set

notGuaranteedFields.name: description
notGuaranteedFields.description: LNK description string; present only when HAS_NAME flag is set

notGuaranteedFields.name: relative_path
notGuaranteedFields.description: relative path; present only when HAS_RELATIVE_PATH flag is set

notGuaranteedFields.name: network_share_path
notGuaranteedFields.description: UNC network share path; present only when link_info contains CommonNetworkRelativeLink

notGuaranteedFields.name: tracker_data
notGuaranteedFields.description: distributed link tracker data; present only when HAS_DARWIN_ID flag is set

notGuaranteedFields.name: complex_shell_structures
notGuaranteedFields.description: decompressed/custom shell item types; known limitation documented in parser-support-matrix.md

expected.fieldNamingConvention: camelCase for top-level DTO; snake_case for attrs map keys within artifacts
expected.timezoneNormalizationRule: all FILETIME values converted to UTC via Windows epoch offset (1601-01-01); serialized as RFC 3339; timestamps outside year range 2001-2099 are excluded as unreasonable

emptyValueStrategy.null: absent or invalid FILETIME value (zero, max, or out of range)
emptyValueStrategy.emptyString: path not present (neither link_info nor idlist yielded a path)
emptyValueStrategy.zero: valid zero value for counts (e.g. file_size)

expected.sortOrderRule: artifacts sorted by artifact_type family then by creation_time descending; timeline events sorted by timestamp ascending
